definition: A staging artifact is a retained surface that re-serves another surface's retrieval target instead of recording an independent retrieval of its own.

artifacts.why: The stored target is a markdown.new wrapper whose decoded url= parameter is a prefix of the GDDY Yahoo Japan history route, cut off at '?from='; it carries no to= value and no TWLO string, so it can only be a copy of the GDDY block already seen on the earlier surface.

The observation carries its own raw_unzoned timestamp on its own primary source and is 48 minutes 55 seconds later than the GDDY observation; it is not a re-serve of the GDDY block, even though its route is proxy-wrapped and its date window is 48 hours rather than a single day.
